en: Color postcard view across a lakeside path in a leafy park, with two people walking in the foreground and a large Stalinist high‑rise crowned by a tall spire across the water. A small boat is on the lake; a lamp post and poplars line the path. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Bucharest postmark, a Romanian stamp, and printed caption indicating Bucharest/Parcul Herăstrău.
